verdict.rationale: One hands-on community report describes using Claude Design with PenPot through PenPot's MCP. The product page also shows Claude Design pulling data from external apps like Salesforce, QuickBooks, Canva and HubSpot, which suggests tool connectors. However, no first-party documentation explicitly says users can plug arbitrary MCP servers into Claude Design, and it is unclear whether the PenPot flow ran inside Claude Design or through Claude Code. Missing for 10: first-party docs on adding or configuring MCP servers in Claude Design, an explicit statement that the named app integrations are MCP-based, and clear independent corroboration that tools are invoked from within Claude Design itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Claude Design into PenPot via its MCP was a really neat flow, with correct prompts it even built out reusable PenPot components and design system tokens.
